task: REAL ENERGY-DEMAND DATA PATH DECISION RECORD
architectural_compatibility: NO FROZEN-CONTRACT INCOMPATIBILITY IDENTIFIED DURING RECONNAISSANCE/INSPECTION
purpose: Provide neutral decision support comparing Path A (Formal Restricted-Data Access) and Path B (Explicitly Authorized Hybrid Scenario) without ranking, scoring, or recommending.

inspected_evidence.sites_nuolja: Real hourly SW_IN data exists, but NOT electrical demand.
inspected_evidence.aadc_antarctic: Monthly energy totals available, but not continuous high-resolution demand series.
inspected_evidence.sanae_iv: Literature describes 1h logging, but raw measured time series access is restricted.
inspected_evidence.princess_elisabeth: Literature describes operational profiles, but raw telemetry access is restricted.
inspected_evidence.acep_arctic: Microgrid load information exists, but raw data access is restricted/institutional.
inspected_evidence.openei_kaggle: Explicitly treated as synthetic/anonymized proxies, NOT real polar station demand.

decision_required.statement: The project team must decide whether to pursue formal restricted-data access (Path A) or separately authorize a clearly labelled hybrid scenario (Path B).

path_a_formal_restricted_data_access.objective: Pursue formal access to a restricted continuous high-resolution measured polar-station electrical-demand dataset.
path_a_formal_restricted_data_access.required_inputs: Authorized raw measured electrical demand time-series data from an active or historical polar station.
path_a_formal_restricted_data_access.required_access_authorization: Formal institutional data request, data-sharing agreement, credentials, or explicit operator authorization.
engineering_work_required_after_authoriz: Inspect and validate raw measurement quality, timestamps, missing values, and physical units
Determine temporal resolution, coverage, and continuity
Assess boundary compatibility with StationState and LocalDataProvider
Design, implement, and verify dedicated RealDataIngestionAdapter
Execute validation suite on adapter output
path_a_formal_restricted_data_access.scientific_validity: If obtained and validated, allows claiming system execution and evaluation against actual measured polar-station electrical demand.
what_it_does_not_allow_to_claim: Does NOT allow claiming global generalization across all polar stations
Does NOT allow claiming real-world physical safety guarantees or live operational control validation
Does NOT allow claiming empirical Stage8.1 -> EMS causality unless Stage8.1 is also authorized and connected
main_dependencies: Successful formal access approval from station data owners
Delivery of uncorrupted, continuous, high-resolution demand series
main_limitations: Unpredictable timelines for institutional approval (NOT ESTABLISHED BY CURRENT EVIDENCE)
Potential data gaps, confidentiality restrictions, or non-disclosure terms
path_a_formal_restricted_data_access.reproducibility_implications: If access is restricted/proprietary, third-party reproduction may require explicit access credentials or data-sharing agreements.
path_a_formal_restricted_data_access.relationship_to_frozen_architecture: Integrates upstream of LocalDataProvider via a dedicated adapter. Requires zero changes to frozen EMS, MILP, MPC, or Digital Twin logic.
preconditions_before_implementation: Formal project decision selecting Path A
Approval and delivery of authorized measured dataset

path_b_explicitly_authorized_hybrid_scen.objective: Construct and evaluate an explicitly labelled hybrid scenario combining legitimate measured renewable/weather observations with explicitly modelled demand components.
required_inputs: Real measured solar irradiance / weather observations (e.g., SITES Nuolja SW_IN)
Clearly identified measured demand sources where legitimately available
Explicitly documented synthetic/modelled demand trajectories where measured station demand is unavailable
path_b_explicitly_authorized_hybrid_scen.required_access_authorization: Explicit project governance authorization to define and execute a hybrid scenario.
engineering_work_required_after_authoriz: Define explicit mathematical models or profile generators for station demand
Implement hybrid data provider / scenario generator
Label all outputs explicitly as HYBRID / MODELLED-SYSTEM artifacts
Validate dataset integrity through DataProvider -> StationState pipeline
path_b_explicitly_authorized_hybrid_scen.scientific_validity: Allows evaluating EMS/MPC optimization performance and control interactions under realistic environmental driving conditions with explicitly controlled demand assumptions.
what_it_does_not_allow_to_claim: Must NOT be presented as a fully measured polar-station system
Must NOT be claimed as real-station empirical validation
Must NOT be claimed as empirical validation of actual station demand
Must NOT be claimed as a replacement for the missing measured-demand dataset
main_dependencies: Project governance authorization for hybrid scope
main_limitations: Demand profiles rely on synthetic/modelled assumptions rather than empirical telemetry
path_b_explicitly_authorized_hybrid_scen.reproducibility_implications: Fully reproducible using open weather datasets and published demand model scripts.
path_b_explicitly_authorized_hybrid_scen.relationship_to_frozen_architecture: Fully compatible with LocalDataProvider and existing pipeline; requires zero modifications to downstream frozen contracts.
preconditions_before_implementation: Formal project decision selecting Path B
Written governance authorization specifying allowed hybrid parameters and explicit labelling rules

primary_data_source.path_a: Real measured polar station demand time series

scientific_claim_boundaries: Neither Path A nor Path B, by itself, automatically establishes real-station operational validation.
Neither path automatically establishes generalization across polar stations.
Neither path automatically establishes global EMS robustness guarantees.
Neither path automatically establishes real-world physical safety guarantees.
Neither path automatically establishes empirical Stage8.1 -> EMS causality.
Neither path automatically establishes universal forecasting-to-operations benefit.

architectural_compatibility.finding: No frozen-contract incompatibility was identified during reconnaissance/inspection; adapter feasibility appears possible, subject to obtaining and validating the required high-resolution measurements.
clarifications: Does NOT mean adapter is validated
Does NOT mean adapter is ready
Does NOT mean real-data integration is complete
Does NOT mean real-data compatibility is 100% proven
Does NOT mean real-data path has been experimentally demonstrated
architectural_compatibility.target_pipeline: Real measured demand -> authorized provider/adapter -> StationState -> existing ForecastEngine boundary -> ForecastBundle v1.0 -> frozen EMS / MILP / MPC -> DispatchPlan -> DigitalTwin -> Evaluation

decision_authority.decision_required: The project team must decide whether to pursue formal restricted-data access (Path A) or separately authorize a clearly labelled hybrid scenario (Path B).
decision_authority.authorization_status: No implementation should begin until that decision is explicitly authorized. Creation of this decision record does NOT constitute authorization for either path.

required_next_action_after_human_decisio: Once the project team renders a formal decision: if Path A is selected, initiate formal data request process; if Path B is selected, draft hybrid scenario specification document. No software implementation, data ingestion, or experiment shall be initiated prior to explicit authorization.
